sloka: विधवा पृथिवी राजम्स् त्वया हीना न राजते ।हीन चन्द्रा इव रजनी नगरी प्रतिभाति माम् ॥२-७६-९॥
transliteration: vidhavā pṛthivī rājams tvayā hīnā na rājate ।hīna candrā iva rajanī nagarī pratibhāti mām ॥2-76-9॥

translations.english: O king bereft of you, the earth (kingdom) is widowed and has lost its radiance. The city appears to me like a moonless night.
